findings.recommendation: Move all state changes before external calls (follow the CEI pattern). Alternatively, add a `nonReentrant` modifier from OpenZeppelin's ReentrancyGuard.

findings.title: Unsafe downcast to `uint32`
findings.description: The value `block` is cast to `uint32` without bounds checking. If the value exceeds the maximum for `uint32` (2^32 - 1), it will silently truncate, leading to incorrect values.
findings.recommendation: Use OpenZeppelin's SafeCast library: `value.toUint32()` which reverts on overflow. Alternatively, add an explicit bounds check.

findings.title: Division before multiplication (precision loss)
findings.description: The expression `(TickMath.MIN_TICK / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing` performs division before multiplication, which truncates the intermediate result and can cause significant precision loss in Solidity's integer arithmetic. For example, `(a / b) * c` loses the remainder of `a / b` before multiplying.
findings.recommendation: Reorder to multiply before dividing: `a * c / b`. For cases where overflow is a concern, use a `mulDiv` function (e.g., OpenZeppelin's Math.mulDiv or Uniswap's FullMath.mulDiv).

findings.title: Division before multiplication (precision loss)
findings.description: The expression `(TickMath.MIN_TICK / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing` performs division before multiplication, which truncates the intermediate result and can cause significant precision loss in Solidity's integer arithmetic. findings.recommendation: Add the `nonReentrant` modifier to prevent reentrancy. Import and inherit from OpenZeppelin's ReentrancyGuard.

findings.description: Division by `v3` without a preceding zero check. If `v3` can be zero, this will cause a revert (Solidity 0.8+) or return zero (Solidity <0.8), both of which may be unintended.
findings.recommendation: Add `require(v3 != 0, "Division by zero");` before this operation, or handle the zero case explicitly.

findings.title: Unsafe downcast to `uint8`
findings.description: The value `48` is cast to `uint8` without bounds checking. If the value exceeds the maximum for `uint8` (2^8 - 1), it will silently truncate, leading to incorrect values.
findings.recommendation: Use OpenZeppelin's SafeCast library: `value.toUint8()` which reverts on overflow. Alternatively, add an explicit bounds check.

findings.title: Unsafe downcast to `uint8`
findings.description: The value `uint256` is cast to `uint8` without bounds checking. If the value exceeds the maximum for `uint8` (2^8 - 1), it will silently truncate, leading to incorrect values.
findings.recommendation: Use OpenZeppelin's SafeCast library: `value.toUint8()` which reverts on overflow. Alternatively, add an explicit bounds check.

findings.title: Division before multiplication (precision loss)
findings.description: The expression `(tick == (TickMath.MIN_TICK / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing` performs division before multiplication, which truncates the intermediate result and can cause significant precision loss in Solidity's integer arithmetic. For example, `(a / b) * c` loses the remainder of `a / b` before multiplying.
findings.recommendation: Reorder to multiply before dividing: `a * c / b`. For cases where overflow is a concern, use a `mulDiv` function (e.g., OpenZeppelin's Math.mulDiv or Uniswap's FullMath.mulDiv).

findings.title: Potential division by zero: `/ tickSpacing)`

findings.recommendation: Add `require(tickSpacing) != 0, "Division by zero");` before this operation, or handle the zero case explicitly.

findings.title: Division before multiplication (precision loss)
findings.description: The expression `(tick == (TickMath.MAX_TICK / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing` performs division before multiplication, which truncates the intermediate result and can cause significant precision loss in Solidity's integer arithmetic. For example, `(a / b) * c` loses the remainder of `a / b` before multiplying.
findings.recommendation: Reorder to multiply before dividing: `a * c / b`. For cases where overflow is a concern, use a `mulDiv` function (e.g., OpenZeppelin's Math.mulDiv or Uniswap's FullMath.mulDiv).

findings.title: Division before multiplication (precision loss)
findings.description: The expression `(tick == (TickMath.MIN_TICK / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing` performs division before multiplication, which truncates the intermediate result and can cause significant precision loss in Solidity's integer arithmetic. findings.title: Unsafe downcast to `int128`
findings.description: The value `positionInfo` is cast to `int128` without bounds checking. If the value exceeds the maximum for `int128` (2^128 - 1), it will silently truncate, leading to incorrect values.
findings.recommendation: Use OpenZeppelin's SafeCast library: `value.toInt128()` which reverts on overflow. Alternatively, add an explicit bounds check.

findings.title: Unsigned to signed integer conversion
findings.description: Converting an unsigned integer to a signed type can produce a negative value if the unsigned value exceeds the signed type's maximum (e.g., uint256 > type(int256).max). In Solidity 0.8+, this reverts; in earlier versions, it wraps.
findings.recommendation: Validate that the value fits in the target signed type before casting. Use SafeCast for safe conversions.

findings.title: Hardcoded 8 decimals assumption (WBTC/Chainlink)
findings.description: The value `1e8` assumes 8 decimals, typical for WBTC/Chainlink. Not all tokens use this decimal precision. Using a hardcoded value can cause incorrect calculations with tokens of different decimals.
findings.recommendation: Use `IERC20Metadata(token).decimals()` to dynamically determine token decimals. If the decimal value must be hardcoded for gas efficiency, document it clearly and validate in the constructor.

findings.title: Read-only reentrancy risk: `snapshotCumulativesInside` may return stale data
findings.description: View function `snapshotCumulativesInside` reads balance/share state that is also modified by `swap` (which has external calls). If `swap` makes an external call before updating state, a callback could invoke `snapshotCumulativesInside` and get stale values. This is exploitable if other protocols rely on this view function.
findings.recommendation: Ensure state is updated before external calls in `swap`. If this view function is used by external protocols for pricing, consider adding reentrancy protection.
findings.code_snippet:
169:     /// @inheritdoc IPancakeV3PoolDerivedState
>>> 170:     function snapshotCumulativesInside(int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper)
    171:         external

findings.recommendation: Add `require(_WETH9 != address(0), "zero address");` or use a custom error for gas efficiency.
